page_transcriptions.text: UOS Partner Information. Office of International Affairs.
Name of University: University of Seoul (UOS). Mailing Address: University of Seoul, Office of International Affairs, 163 Seoulsiripdae-ro, Dongdaemun-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea 02504.

Exchange students are those who have applied and are nominated by an overseas university under a formal exchange agreement. Tuition is paid to the home university, and in most cases, the application and documentation fee is waived. Spring Semester: Orientation End of February; Classes begin March 2; Classes end 3rd week of June; Nomination Period September 1 - October 15; Application Deadline September 1 - October 31. Fall Semester: Orientation End of August; Classes begin September 1; Classes end 3rd week of December; Nomination Period March 1 - April 15; Application Deadline March 1 - April 30. Above Information is subject to change and all the changes will be informed accordingly.

What to submit on arrival: (1) One official photo (3.5cm x 4.5cm, full color with white background) for alien registration. (2) Certificate of Health, TB test result (or Chest X-ray) (it is a mandatory document only for on-campus housing residents and required to submit to housing office at check-in). Language requirements (i.e.TOEFL scores): N/A. Applicants should have good commend of either Korean or English. Minimum Academic Performance (i.e.GPA scores): A minimum GPA of 2.5 on a 4.0 scale (GPA by US standard) or grades equivalent to a B average. We cannot guarantee the courses your students would like to take.

Undergraduate students should have completed at least two terms of university studies. All the courses offered at graduate level are taught in Korean. For the graduate students who are not fluent in Korean is strongly advised to be enrolled to undergraduate program. In this case, the student should ask his/her study abroad coordinator at the home university if this option would be accepted according to the university's policy. Recommended credit points per semester: 15 credits. A student should take at least 6 credits and can take up to 20 credits.

D-2 visa holders are automatically included in the mandatory National Health Insurance program. All international students are required to pay the Health Insurance Fee for Int'l Students every month from alien registration date. No action is required from students, as they are automatically subscribed to health insurance by NHIS (National Health Insurance Service). The Certificate of Health is required to be submitted to on-campus housing office for those who stay on-campus housing.

UOS only secure/guarantee on-campus housing only for those exchange students whose universities secure/guarantee on-campus housing for UOS students. UOS do not secure on-campus housing to all partner universities for dormitory room shortage. Residence Hall: Each room of double occupancy. Using public toilets/shower rooms in corridors. Fees: 764,000KRW/semester. Fees for vacation (about 2 months): 382,000 KRW. Application for vacation: right before each semester ends.

International House: Each unit with 2 rooms / 3 rooms / 4 rooms / 5 rooms of single occupancy. Toilet/shower room inside the house (shared with the housemates). Fees: 1,120,000KRW/semester. Fees for vacation (about 2 months): 560,000KRW. Fees are payable on arrival at UOS. Allocation will be done on random basis. Off-campus housing is a contractual matter between students and accommodation, and the UOS OIA is not involved at all. Please review the terms and conditions of the accommodation contract carefully before you sign the contract.

Visiting Student Program: students from our Partner University who were not able to be nominated as exchange student. Must pay the tuition fee to the University of Seoul. Tuition Fee: From 2,156,000KRW ~ (depends on each department). Deadline: May 31 (for Fall admission) & November 30 (for Spring admission).

Estimated costs: 800,000 KRW - 1,000,000 KRW per month. Including food, local transportation, books, entertainment, etc. Exchange students will hear from SeoulMate by email about a month before each semester starts. GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) for exchange students offer a monthly stipend of 630,000 KRW and roundtrip airfare. UOS's location in Seoul: 10km away from City Hall (North East Seoul). Above information is subject to change.
Office of International Affairs.
